command.description: Command(s) to execute. Either a single string or a list of lines. When string, may contain shell syntax; when list, each element is a line.

args.description: Arguments to pass to the command as positional parameters ($1...$9,$*,$@).

preaction.description: Shell commands prefixed to every action (run before each action).

header.description: Number of top lines of output to exclude from cursor movement.

refresh.description: Whether to re-run the command after executing an action.

autorefresh.description: Automatically re-run command every N seconds. 0 disables.

cursormovement.description: Number of lines cursor moves per UP/DOWN key press.

multilineseperator.description: String inserted between lines when concatenating multi-line selections for actions.

uservars.description: Number of user variables ($BOSHVAR1, $BOSHVAR2, …) to allocate.

actions.description: List of action definitions, where each item is a mapping with 'key' (a single character or Enter) and 'command' (string) OR extended form with 'mode' ('.' | '>' | '!') and optional 'prompt'. For example: { 'key': 'k', 'command': 'kill $BOSH' } or { 'key': 'e', 'mode': '!', 'command': 'pico $BOSH' } or { 'key': 's', 'mode': '!', 'prompt': 'signal', 'command': 'kill -s $BOSHPARAM $PID' }
